Points credited to the home team at the event that earned them, so free throws are attributed to the foul rather than to each attempt. Use for on-off and plus-minus calculations, where a substitution between free throws would otherwise misattribute the points.
Same as shot_pts_home, for the away team.

Equals 1 when a home possession is credited at this event, attributed to the event that earned it rather than to the final free throw. Use for on-off and lineup possession counts, where a substitution between free throws would otherwise misattribute the possession.
